1.2KG OF COOKED CHICKEN FOR £4.99 AT FARMFOODS! Now this is one worth having a look at if you’re trying to keep the weekly food shop under control! 👀 Farmfoods has its 1.2kg packs of cooked chicken fillet for £4.99 each in a 14 Day Special. 📅 Monday 26th October to Sunday 8th November 2026. There are three varieties shown: 🍗 Cooked, sliced & roasted chicken fillet 🍗 Cooked diced chicken fillet 🍗 Cooked sliced chicken fillet That works out at around £4.16 per kg — and because it’s designed to be used from frozen, it’s handy to have in the freezer ready for those days when you need something quick. 💡 Here’s where it could help your budget: add it to pasta, curries, fajitas, stir-fries, salads or a jacket potato. You can turn one pack into several portions by combining it with cheaper ingredients like rice, pasta, vegetables or wraps. Instead of buying individual portions or ordering a takeaway when you’re short on time, having something like this in the freezer could help you put together a quick meal without the extra expense. 🥘 As always, compare the price per kilo with other chicken options, and check the pack size and ingredients before buying. The offer is available while stocks last, with a maximum of five packs per customer per day. 💷 It All Stacks Up! Raising chickens for meat has changed the way we look at food. 🐓❤️ It’s not just about putting food on the table. It’s about knowing where it came from, how it was raised, and the life it lived. We believe that if we’re going to raise animals for food, we have a responsibility to give them the best life we can. Fresh air. Sunshine. Room to roam. A life worth living. ❤️ Our goal isn’t just to produce our own food. It’s to raise it with care, respect, and purpose. And there’s something incredibly rewarding about that. 🌱 Follow Family First Farmstead as we learn to become more self-sufficient, one step at a time.
